framing.header: little-endian u32 record count followed by that many absolute little-endian u32 offsets
framing.record: little-endian u32 compressed byte length, little-endian u32 decoded byte length, then exactly that many Brotli bytes
framing.boundary: first offset equals offset-table end, records are contiguous in table order, final record ends at EOF

evidenceBoundary.exact: The selected decoder closure and current VFS file bytes are checked before decoding; the closure is checked again afterward. The reviewed decoder rejects malformed offsets, length mismatch, Brotli, UTF-16LE and JSON, and the corpus gate rechecks its manifest against every source offset and EOF.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: JSON graph meaning is separately constrained by extend_data_graph_schema.json.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Installed runtime producer/consumer, graph owner and execution.
